title: EP 12 — PICK UP RIGHT WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
lines: Closed your terminal and lost the whole conversation with Claude?
Closed your terminal, and lost the whole conversation with Clawd?
You didn't. Claude saves every session to disk as you work.
You didn't. Clawd saves every session to disk, as you work.
claude --continue picks the most recent one back up.
Claude, dash dash continue, picks the most recent one back up. Right where you left off.
claude --resume opens a picker of your past sessions.
Claude, dash dash resume, opens a picker of all your past sessions.
Name one with -n, then resume it by name later.
Name one with dash n, then resume it by name, later.
Already in a session? /resume switches you to another.
Already in a session? Slash resume switches you to another one.
Even after /clear, the old conversation is still there.
Even after slash clear, the old conversation is still saved, and resumable.
Follow for a fresh Claude Code tip every day.
Follow for a fresh Clawd Code tip, every day.
